packs.title: Art, Parks and Stories
packs.promise: Explore Cincinnati through separate art, park and history outings.

q.s: Compare two credited works through one visual idea.
st: Choose two credited works in open general galleries and record their makers or source labels.
Find one color, material or framing decision that links the works and one that separates them.
Make an original two-work comparison, labeling any interpretation as your own.

q.s: Trace one Art Deco decision in a working station.
st: Use an open public approach or official image to choose one arch, surface or entrance pattern.
Read the museum center's history of the terminal before naming the design feature.
Draw a compact form map showing how that feature guides or frames arrival; mark observation separately from inference.

q.s: Compare two labeled plant forms in open displays.
st: Choose two labeled plants in rooms open to visitors, or two current official plant descriptions.
Record one visible leaf, stem or growth-form difference without touching either plant.
Write a sourced comparison and one clearly labeled question about adaptation.

packs.title: Downtown to River
packs.promise: Walk Cincinnati's downtown arts, civic spaces and riverfront with care.

q.s: Turn one public library source into a careful question.
st: Choose a public catalog or exhibition record and note its title and credited source.
Record one detail the item actually supports about Cincinnati or the region.
Ask one question it leaves open and name a further source that might answer it.

q.s: Read a contemporary artwork through its chosen material.
st: Choose a credited work in an open gallery or a current official exhibition page.
Record one material, scale or spatial choice that is actually visible.
Make an original two-sentence response: one observation and one labeled interpretation.

q.s: Compare one credited work with its historic room.
st: Choose a credited work or mural in a visitor-open room or official museum image.
Record one detail of the work and one visible feature of its setting.
Compare how the setting changes what you notice, without assigning an unverified intention to its maker.
